messages:
Alex: Heads-up: onboarding sample-app hits spikes of 429s when it paginates and does batch embeddings in parallel. Repro in ~10s.
Meera: Can you drop the repro steps + a tiny log?
Alex: Repro: start quickstart node sampleapp, hit /sync-articles. Paginator prefetch=2 spawns 2 inflight page fetches; each page triggers embeddings.batch() and a couple gen calls. After ~3 pages we get repeated 429s.
Alex: Log: ```
2026-10-12T14:12:03Z ERROR request failed status=429 route=/v1/embeddings model=text-embed-001 client_concurrency=8
2026-10-12T14:12:03Z WARN retrying after 200ms attempt=3
```
Sam: Which SDK? JS or Go?
Alex: JS SDK (sdk-js@0.9.7) + sampleapp. Seen similar in Go but less severe.
Lina: Likely interaction between paginator prefetch + client-side token-bucket. Prefetch kicks off parallel page handlers which each call embeddings -> drains bucket fast.
JD: We switched adaptive-windowing to per-client in INF-3421, could be related.
Meera: So the flow is: prefetch -> concurrent embed requests -> bucket drained -> API 429 -> retries that replay bursts -> sustained 429s?
Alex: Yes. Setting PREFETCH=1 largely prevents it.
Sam: Short-term workaround for customers: set REDWOOD_SDK_PREFETCH_PAGES=1 or client maxConcurrency=2. Add to onboarding docs?
Lina: Opening a minimal failing test for SDK parity (internal link). Branch: devex/fix-prefetch-throttle.
Meera: Root cause: refill rate allows short bursts up to bucket size. Prefetch plus bursty batches exhaust bucket; retry backoff/jitter insufficient so bursts repeat. Go SDK applies per-route buckets which avoided the spiral -> parity gap.
JD: Proposal: (1) default prefetch=1 for quickstart, (2) make JS SDK per-route buckets like Go, (3) improve retry jitter & add cap to exponential backoff.
Alex: I pushed PR to set quickstart prefetch=1 and note in docs.
Sam: I'll own sdk-js changes and add integration test that paginates+parallel-embeds and asserts few 429s in 1m.
Lina: I'll add telemetry to Console to detect sessions causing cross-route 429 spikes.
DeployBot: deployment queued for devex/fix-prefetch-throttle -> staging (ci-integration-27).
Alex: Updated onboarding note: "If you see 429s during quickstart, set REDWOOD_SDK_PREFETCH_PAGES=1 or set client maxConcurrency to 2."
JD: Created INF-3421 P2 assigned to @Sam.
Meera: Once sdk-js fix lands we should revert quickstart to prefetch=2 and mark parity issue resolved.
Sam: Will add PR + ping QA.
Alex: Leaving thread for follow-ups on telemetry/docs/tests.
